newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wage deals pay 4.4 pct rises in Q4.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wage deals pay 4.4 pct rises in Q4.

text.p: Australian enterprise wage deals concluded in the December quarter granted average annualised wage increases of 4.4 percent, down from 4.8 percent in the previous quarter, the Industrial Relations Department said on Wednesdsay.
The quarter's private sector deals also paid average annualised rises of 4.4 percent, down from 5.3 percent in the September quarter.
The department said that 966 enterprise bargaining agreements, covering an estimated 178,300 employees, were formalised by the Industrial Relations Commission in the quarter.

All enterprise agreements current at December 31 -- not just the new ones concluded in the quarter -- paid average annualised wage increases (AAWI) of 4.6 percent for all employees, unchanged from the three months before.
All current agreements in just the private sector paid 4.8 percent average annualised rises, also unchanged.
